```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Todo Detail</title>
    <link href="{{ asset('css/app.css') }}" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans antialiased">
    <div class="container mx-auto py-8 lg:py-16">
        <div class="max-w-md w-full rounded bg-white shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <div class="px-4 py-5 sm:p-6">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ $todo->title }}</h2>
                <p class="mt-1 text-gray-700">{{ $todo->description }}</p>

                <div class="flex items-center mt-4">
                    @if ($todo->completed == false)
                        <button wire:click="toggleCompletion({{ $todo->id }})" class="bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded shadow-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring ring-blue-300">
                            Mark as Complete
                        </button>
                    @else
                        <button wire:click="toggleCompletion({{ $todo->id }})" class="bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded shadow-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring ring-red-300">
                            Mark as Incomplete
                        </button>
                    @endif
                </div>

                <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span wire:click="deleteTodo({{ $todo->id }})" class="text-gray-600 hover:text-red-500 cursor-pointer">Delete</span>
                    <a href="{{ route('todos.index') }}" class="text-gray-600 hover:text-blue-500 cursor-pointer">Back to List</a>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    @livewireScript
</body>
</html>
```

This Blade view includes the necessary HTML structure, Tailwind CSS styling, Alpine.js interactions, and Livewire component calls for toggling completion status and deleting the todo item.
